name: Hirume
source:
Affiliation: Seventh Divine Throne/Shokou Mandala

The one who controls the Seventh-generation Divine Throne, the current god. Though her origin itself is rather peculiar, something she herself is not aware of. She was once overwhelmed by boredom, however when she discovered the protagonist that boredom turned into glee and joy. Because of her ignorance of the ways of the world, she’s somewhat selfish. However, at her core she is a naive girl.

[spoiler]She is the daughter of [url=https://vndb.org/c34796]Habaki[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c34797]Rindo[/url] from Six Heroes that defeat Hajun.[/spoiler]

[Translated from [url=http://dies-p.net/character.html]Dies irae Pantheon's character page[/url]]
